name: Petty Squabbles
label: Quest
description: Petty Squabbles: the quest giver's words, read aloud by the Lore Forever narrators.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: We fight the wrong enemy, friend.
The true power in these lands continues to grow in strength and number while we squabble over scorched earth with orcs.
Do we continue to fight a war in these lands against the Horde, only to be routed one day by the armies of the Burning Legion? It is futile.
Put your differences aside, friend, speak with the fallen hero of the Horde. He knows the truth behind the Blasted Lands.

clips.title: Completion
paras: I thought to never see this day again. A day in which the Alliance fights side by side with the Horde against a common enemy.
It shall be... We will unite.
